code: library(bayesmetaverse)  # attaches bayesmaDatR, inspectR, robbR, bayesma, bayesfoRest bayesmaDatR::launch_data_entry() tw <- inspectR::inspect_sr(dat) inspectR::inspect_sr_table(tw) inspectR::inspect_sr_plot(tw) dat_tw <- inspectR::filter_trustworthy(dat, tw) robbR::rob_plot(rob_dat) bayesma::primed(dat) fit_prior <- bayesma::bayesma(dat, sample_prior = TRUE) bayesma::pp_check(fit_prior) fit <- bayesma::bayesma(dat, stage = "one_stage") bayesma::diagnostics(fit) bayesma::pp_check(fit) cmp <- bayesma::compare_models(fit, fit_alt) bayesma::compare_table(cmp) bayesma::compare_plot(cmp) bayesma::funnel_plot(fit) bayesma::egger(fit) bayesma::robma(dat) fit_mix <- bayesma::bayesma(dat, re_dist = "mixture") bayesfoRest::forest(fit) mr <- bayesma::meta_reg(dat, moderator = ~ dose) bayesma::metareg_mod_plot(mr) bayesfoRest::forest(fit, subgroup = TRUE) bayesma::sensitivity_plot(fit) bayesma::interpret(fit) bayesma::overall_plot(fit) bayesfoRest::forest(fit)

title: Bayes-Metaverse: Tools, Methods and Resources for Bayesian Meta-Analysis
text: Bayes-Metaverse brings together R package suite, practical guidance links established software support transparent, reproducible workflow Bayesian meta-analysis (Bayesian MA). aim help researchers move clearly specified review question data preparation, model fitting checking, sensitivity analysis, interpretation. project organised around workflow rather single model. Different reviews need different likelihoods, effect measures, priors sensitivity analyses; workflow makes choices explicit documents made. See Getting Started full workflow.
